newsitem.title: UK: Boots profits up 9.4 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: Boots profits up 9.4 pct in first half.

text.p: Retailer and chemist group Boots Co Plc on Thursday on Thursday reported a 9.4 percent rise in first half profits and said it had seen a general upturn in the retail climate.

Pretax profits before exceptional items rose to 239.2 million pounds ($393.9 million) in the six months to September 30 from 218.7 million. Overall sales increased to 2.12 billion pounds from 1.89 billion. The dividend was up 8.8 percent to 6.2 pence a share.
Boots' chairman Sir Michael Angus said the company was encouraged by the general improvement in the UK retail trade, and expressed optimism about the outlook for the key Christmas season.
"The pre-Christmas period retains its importance for the company as a whole," he said in a statement. "We are confident of good seasonal sales despite an increasingly competitive environment."
The group's main business Boots The Chemist increased profits to 184.0 million pounds from 164.3 million. ($1=.6072 Pound)
